sn55.23:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.23:1.2: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena godhā sakko tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā godhaṃ sakkaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.23:1.3: “katīhi tvaṃ godhe, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti”?
sn55.23:2.1: tīhi khvāhaṃ mahānāma, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:2.3: idha mahānāma, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.23:2.4: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.23:2.7: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
sn55.23:2.8: imehi kho’haṃ mahānāma, tīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:3.1: tvaṃ pana mahānāma, katihi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti?
sn55.23:3.2: catūhi khvāhaṃ bho godhe, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:3.4: idha bho godhe, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.23:3.5: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”tīhi
sn55.23:3.8: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.23:3.9: imehi khvāhaṃ godhe catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi. avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti.
sn55.23:4.1: āgamehi tvaṃ mahānāma, āgamehi tvaṃ mahānāma,
sn55.23:4.2: bhagavāva etaṃ jāneyya etehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ vā asamannāgataṃ vāti.
sn55.23:4.3: āyāma godhe, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāmāti.
sn55.23:4.4: atha kho mahānāmo ca sakko godhā ca sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.23:5.1: “idhāhaṃ bhante, yena godhā sakko tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā godhaṃ sakkaṃ etadavocaṃ:
sn55.23:5.2: katīhi tvaṃ godhe, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti?
sn55.23:5.3: evaṃ vutte bhante, godhā sakko maṃ etadavoca:
sn55.23:6.1: tīhi khvāhaṃ mahānāma, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:6.3: idha mahānāma, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.23:6.4: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.23:6.8: imehi kho’haṃ mahānāma, tīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:6.9: tvaṃ pana mahānāma, katīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti?
sn55.23:7.1: evaṃ vutte’haṃ bhante, godhaṃ sakkaṃ etadavocaṃ:
sn55.23:7.2: catūhi khvāhaṃ godhe, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇaṃ.
sn55.23:7.4: idha godhe, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.23:7.5: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.23:7.8: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.23:7.9: imehi kho’haṃ godhe, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalaṃ ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇanti.
sn55.23:8.1: evaṃ vutte bhante, godhā sakko maṃ etadavoca:
sn55.23:8.2: āgamehi tvaṃ mahānāma, āgamehi tvaṃ mahānāma,
sn55.23:8.3: bhagavāva etaṃ jāneyya etehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ vā asamannāgataṃ vāti.
sn55.23:8.4: idha bhante, kocideva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho, ca.
sn55.23:8.6: evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu.
sn55.23:8.7: idha bhante, kocideva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho, ekato bhikkhunisaṅgho ca,
sn55.23:8.9: evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu.
sn55.23:8.10: idha bhante, kocideva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya. ekato assa bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho, ekato bhikkhunīsaṅgho, upāsakā ca.
sn55.23:8.12: evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu.
sn55.23:8.13: idha bhante, kocideva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya. ekato assa bhagavā, ekato bhikkhusaṅgho, ekato bhikkhunīsaṅgho upāsakā upāsikāyo ca,
sn55.23:8.15: evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretu.
sn55.23:8.16: idha bhante, kocideva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya, ekato assa bhagavā, ekato bhikkhusaṅgho, ekato bhikkhunīsaṅgho, upāsakā upāsikāyo sadevako ca loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā.
sn55.23:8.18: evaṃ pasannaṃ maṃ bhante, bhagavā dhāretūti.
sn55.23:8.19: evaṃvādī tvaṃ godhe, mahānāmaṃ sakkaṃ kiṃ vadesīti?
sn55.23:8.20: evaṃvādāhaṃ bhante, mahānāmaṃ sakkaṃ na kiñci vadāmi, aññatra kalyāṇā aññatra kusalāti.
